title: Mikey defies Sandman and Steve Austin
summary: Mikey Whipwreck’s unlikely rise reaches the world championship. Sandman and an angry Steve Austin test whether the underdog can survive as the wrestler everyone is chasing.

chapters.title: Mikey wins the world title
chapters.result: Whipwreck defeats Sandman for the championship.
chapters.context: The former perennial loser completes an improbable climb to the top.

chapters.title: Austin fails to take the title
chapters.context: Mikey withstands a challenger who believes he deserves a much bigger stage.

chapters.title: Sandman wins the three-way dance
chapters.result: Sandman defeats Whipwreck and Austin for the championship.
chapters.context: The three-way contest ends Mikey’s reign and restores Sandman as champion.
